title: test_create_project_with_valid_details
description: Verify that POST /api/projects with valid project details returns 201 status and the created project data.

title: test_get_project_list
description: Verify that GET /api/projects returns 200 status with a list of projects.

title: test_get_project_details_by_id
description: Verify that GET /api/projects/:id with a valid project ID returns 200 status with full project details.

title: test_create_project_with_missing_fields
description: Verify that POST /api/projects with missing required fields returns 400 status with validation error response.

title: test_get_nonexistent_project
description: Verify that GET /api/projects/:id for a non-existent project returns 404 status with not found response.

title: test_create_specification_with_valid_dimensions
description: Verify that POST /api/specifications with valid room dimensions and floor data returns 201 status with calculated specification output.

title: test_get_specification_by_id
description: Verify that GET /api/specifications/:id returns 200 status with saved room specification and derived quantities.

title: test_update_specification_with_valid_data
description: Verify that PUT /api/specifications/:id with updated dimensions returns 200 status with recalculated results.

title: test_create_specification_with_invalid_dimensions
description: Verify that POST /api/specifications with invalid dimensions or malformed payload returns 400 status with validation errors.

title: test_update_specification_with_unsupported_data
description: Verify that PUT /api/specifications/:id with unsupported room data returns 422 status with calculation or business-rule error.
